scope: MAJOR: the field table the ps delta decoder actually uses is at 0xDA8520, NOT 0xDA63E8
consequences: EVERY field-index/codec mapping in this project so far was built on the 0xDA63E8 table (24 entries, offsets 76/80/84/... and codecs -58/-100/...)
the table the decoder is actually indexing starts at 0xDA8520 (or is indexed from there) and its first entry is offset 0 / codec -97
so all previous conclusions of the form 'index N has offset X and codec Y' are INVALID - they described a different table
this single fact explains why the cost model kept matching while the content never did: the framing arithmetic was measured, but the field identities were wrong
open: the struct behind this table is much larger than 88 bytes (offsets up to 1384), so this is probably the player ENTITY state, not the small playerstate
the decoder entry with field index 0 on our V=22 body suggests V means 'number of fields / last changed index + 1' and that decoding starts at field 0 every time
next: re-derive the field semantics from THIS table (0xDA8520) and re-check the V semantics against it
the -97 codec at index 0 costs 1 bit + 32 bits (absolute scalar), which is a plausible commandTime
